class_name: 願望-働きかけ-ネガイタイ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: I would like to ask you to …
patterns.usage_note: Makes a formal request that the addressee do something: お/ご plus a verbal noun, or お plus a masu-stem, followed by 願いたい (ご確認願いたい, お送り願いたい). It belongs to written notices, business letters, and official announcements, and is more distant and impersonal than 〜ていただきたい. Spoken announcements use 願います (お待ち願います) instead.

examples.ruby: 詳細[しょうさい]については担当者[たんとうしゃ]にご確認[かくにん]願[ねが]いたい。
examples.english: For details, we ask that you check with the person in charge.

examples.ruby: 資料[しりょう]は締[し]め切[き]りの前日[ぜんじつ]までにお送[おく]り願[ねが]いたい。
examples.english: We ask that the materials be sent in by the day before the deadline.

examples.ruby: 開演[かいえん]までロビーで静[しず]かにお待[ま]ち願[ねが]いたい。
examples.english: Patrons are asked to wait quietly in the lobby until curtain.
